entry.title: Reuse the redactor for each program status report
entry.content:
Reuse the redactor for each program status report

Share one redactor between each report's ID and message to avoid
initializing the matcher twice. Keep flushing after each field so
partial secret matches cannot carry into the next field.

entry.title: Record OSC program status reports as span events
entry.content:
Record OSC program status reports as span events

Include record IDs, states and redacted messages on the active hook
or phase span so status transitions can be inspected in traces.
Document the OSC keys and event export limits.
